programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Al Shines, former king of the US race car track circuit, has a hard time starting his own team, once he's fired by his sponsor Robin Cates. Robin hired Al's immature daughter Kylie Shines instead. She resents Al's inevitable 'absence' as a widowed father, as well as the reigning champion, equally young but professionally vetted Kid Walker. Kylie tries to prove herself against Kid while having an on-off affair with him. Cates's marketing strategy dictates his intentions to manipulate Walker and both Shines racers.

programme.title: The Wild Girl
programme.desc: Ned Giles, an aspiring news photographer, joins the 1932 Great Apache Expedition on the search for a young boy, the son of a wealthy Mexican land owner who was kidnapped by wild Apaches. Ned finds himself on an unexpected and perilous journey through rugged terrain, when a captured wild Apache girl must be exchanged for the kidnapped boy.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments
programme.desc: One of the most famous stories from The Bible, this mini-series sees the Hebrew infant, Moses, being raised in the Egyptian royal household. When his true identity is revealed, he sets out to reclaim his heritage. Later, the plagues descend on Egypt, and Pharaoh frees the Hebrews only to change his mind and pursue them to the Red Sea where the parting of the waves ensures their escape. After receiving the Ten Commandments, Moses faces an orgy of excess amongst his tribe.

The story twists and turns to an exciting and unexpected finale.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Sherlock Homes: The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson are called to Whitechapel after learning about a series of strange murders only two years after the Jack the Ripper murders in the same neighborhood. The local belief is that the killings are the work of a vampire brought back from a recent mission in Guyana. As they investigate the deaths, they engage in an ongoing debate about the supernatural, with Watson believing in the possibility of vampires and Holmes remaining skeptical until he is able to prove the murders are the works of a living human, rather than any undead creature. At one point, the investigation leads them to the psychic Madame Karasky, who says that Holmes will be saved by the church. Shortly thereafter, Holmes is pushed in front of a moving carriage by the supposed vampire, only to be saved by a pedestrian. In order to catch the murderer, Holmes disguises himself as a monk and reveals that the vampire was Brother Abel, who hoped to get revenge on the monks who didn't listen to him when he believed that the bats were causing rabies in the South American mission, when he was infected. The film ends at Baker Street, when Mrs. Hudson gives Holmes his pipe, delivered by the same man that saved Holmes from being run over. When Holmes asks his name, Mrs. Hudson says his name was Reginald Church.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno (star of the 1970s/80s TV series The Incredible Hulk), Sybil Danning, Ingrid Anderson and Mirella D'Angelo take the lead roles in Italian writer-director Luigi Cozzi's mythological romp for the low-budget action specialists The Cannon Group. The narrative starts with the creation of the universe, at the end of which Pandora's jar is broken, releasing evil into the world. Greek god Zeus (Claudio Cassinelli) decides to protect mankind from evil by creating a hero and sends divine light down to Bronze Age Thebes, where it enters the body of a royal baby. The infant survives a bloody palace coup instigated by Adriana (Danning), daughter of a rival monarch, and the malicious interventions of Zeus's wronged wife Hera (Rossana Podestŕ) to become the immensely strong Hercules (Ferrigno). But adulthood doesn't see an end to the relentless campaign to destroy him. And when Adriana captures his love Cassiopea (Anderson), Hercules joins forces with the sorceress Circe (D'Angelo) to save Cassiopea.

programme.title: The Hollywood Mom's Mystery
programme.desc: Lucy Freers has a long-standing marriage, a nine-year old daughter, and a great family life in the suburbs of Hollywood. Great, that is, until the Hollywood set decides that motherhood is the newest way to go. When local neighbor Julia Prentice, the wife of a famous movie actor, adopts a baby in full view of the show-business media, the parenthood craze hits its peak. Soon after, Julia is found lying dead in Lucy's swimming pool, with Lucy and her husband labeled as suspects. Now Lucy must determine the truth to clear the name of both herself and her family.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: The story is about Kunal (Kunal Khemu) who believes he can do anything by trying his hardest. He receives a job offer through his friend Shawn (Teeshay) and his wife Nandini (Puja Gupta (actress)) in Cape Town and moves there with his wife Aarzoo (Amrita Puri). They live a happy life together, until Kunal becomes extremely workaholic. Kunal's nature irritates Aarzoo which leads to frequent outbursts and quarrels. Kunal becomes the most trusted employee of his boss Dharmesh Zaveri (Manish Chaudhary). This thing angers Dinesh Zaveri, Dharmesh Zaveri's younger brother. Kunal advances in his job. Soon Dharmesh is revealed to be an underworld gangster. The company Kunal works in deals with exporting diamonds; Kunal has no idea that it happens illegally. His boss, Mr. Zakaria, sends his hot colleague Rosa to charm Kunal and take him away from his wife. Following the day when Kunal gets drunk in a party, Rosa takes advantage and manages to make love with him. Kunal reaches his house and finds Aarzoo sleeping and accidentally wakes her up, after which they both pick up a quarrel. Soon enough, Kunal realises the crime he is a part of and decides to and leave Cape Town. However, Zakaria knows that Kunal is aware of the illegal business and the only way to keep him silent is to kill him.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno (star of the 1970s/80s TV series The Incredible Hulk), Sybil Danning, Ingrid Anderson and Mirella D'Angelo take the lead roles in Italian writer-director Luigi Cozzi's mythological romp for the low-budget action specialists The Cannon Group. The narrative starts with the creation of the universe, at the end of which Pandora's jar is broken, releasing evil into the world. Greek god Zeus (Claudio Cassinelli) decides to protect mankind from evil by creating a hero and sends divine light down to Bronze Age Thebes, where it enters the body of a royal baby. The infant survives a bloody palace coup instigated by Adriana (Danning), daughter of a rival monarch, and the malicious interventions of Zeus's wronged wife Hera (Rossana Podestŕ) to become the immensely strong Hercules (Ferrigno). But adulthood doesn't see an end to the relentless campaign to destroy him. And when Adriana captures his love Cassiopea (Anderson), Hercules joins forces with the sorceress Circe (D'Angelo) to save Cassiopea.

programme.title: Sherlock Homes: The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson are called to Whitechapel after learning about a series of strange murders only two years after the Jack the Ripper murders in the same neighborhood. The local belief is that the killings are the work of a vampire brought back from a recent mission in Guyana. As they investigate the deaths, they engage in an ongoing debate about the supernatural, with Watson believing in the possibility of vampires and Holmes remaining skeptical until he is able to prove the murders are the works of a living human, rather than any undead creature. At one point, the investigation leads them to the psychic Madame Karasky, who says that Holmes will be saved by the church. Shortly thereafter, Holmes is pushed in front of a moving carriage by the supposed vampire, only to be saved by a pedestrian. In order to catch the murderer, Holmes disguises himself as a monk and reveals that the vampire was Brother Abel, who hoped to get revenge on the monks who didn't listen to him when he believed that the bats were causing rabies in the South American mission, when he was infected. The film ends at Baker Street, when Mrs. Hudson gives Holmes his pipe, delivered by the same man that saved Holmes from being run over. When Holmes asks his name, Mrs. Hudson says his name was Reginald Church.

James Spader and Angela Bassett star.

programme.title: Sorority Wars
programme.desc: Katie Parker (Lucy Hale) and Sara Snow (Phoebe Strole) have been friends since childhood. They enter college together, where Katie is a prized legacy candidate for the Delta sorority, which was co-founded decades ago by her mother, Lutie (Courtney Thorne-Smith) and Summer (Faith Ford), whose own daughter Gwen (Amanda Schull) now leads the Deltas on campus. Events occur during pledge week to cause a rift between Katie and the Deltas, which leaves Sara as a Delta pledge and Katie out in the cold. Katie joins the rival Kappa sorority, and the rivalry splits not just Katie and Sara, but extends all the way into the Delta alumnae association led by Lutie and Summer.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Barcelona" - "Hapoel TA"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Atėnų „Panathinaikos“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Forged in Fire
programme.desc: Forged in Fire, an American competition series aired on the History Channel, challenges four new competitors to produce a knife in their own style with a small variety of metal objects to create from. The series, hosted by Wil Willis, consists of a three-round elimination contest to forge bladed weapons, with the final winner receiving $10,000 and the day's championship title. Judged by experts in weapon history and use, the last two people standing must create in their own forge a Moro Kris sword, a blade which dates back to 300BC, in just five days. Filmed in Brooklyn, New York, the set referred to as "The Forge" sets the scene for this suspenseful show with propane forges, power hammers and hydraulic presses, with medical personnel being close by to treat any injuries or other health problems. If the medical personnel suspect that the competitors are unable to continue safely, they will be disqualified. Once each competitor has created their weapon, it will be put through a series of tests including chopping/slashing/stabbing objects such as ropes, ice blocks, animal carcasses and steel car doors. Having to meet a number of criteria's, the smiths battle it out, without their swords, to become the best black-smith.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Forged in Fire
programme.desc: Forged in Fire, an American competition series aired on the History Channel, challenges four new competitors to produce a knife in their own style with a small variety of metal objects to create from. The series, hosted by Wil Willis, consists of a three-round elimination contest to forge bladed weapons, with the final winner receiving $10,000 and the day's championship title. Judged by experts in weapon history and use, the last two people standing must create in their own forge a Moro Kris sword, a blade which dates back to 300BC, in just five days. Filmed in Brooklyn, New York, the set referred to as "The Forge" sets the scene for this suspenseful show with propane forges, power hammers and hydraulic presses, with medical personnel being close by to treat any injuries or other health problems. If the medical personnel suspect that the competitors are unable to continue safely, they will be disqualified. Once each competitor has created their weapon, it will be put through a series of tests including chopping/slashing/stabbing objects such as ropes, ice blocks, animal carcasses and steel car doors. Having to meet a number of criteria's, the smiths battle it out, without their swords, to become the best black-smith.

programme.title: Mountain Men
programme.desc: There are men in America who must still make their living off the land; hunting and trapping to provide for their families. They are MOUNTAIN MEN. Their very survival is predicated on utilizing ancient skills perfected over hundreds of years. This series features a variety of men from Appalachia to the Rocky Mountains to Alaska and follows them as they race against winter to obtain the sustenance and money needed to make it through the coldest months of the year. Eustace Conway lives deep in the mountains of North Carolina on the "Turtle Bay Reserve." He moved here two decades ago in search of a more "truthful" existence. In the years since, he's built a home, and survived by hunting, fishing and raising animals. Tom Orr lives with his wife on the Yaak River in Montana. He is 100 miles from the nearest town, a place he hasn't ventured to in 10 years. John is a trapper by trade and to prepare for winter, he must earn enough money to obtain the supplies he needs. Marty Meierotto, his wife Dominique and their daughter Noah live in the small Alaskan town of Two Rivers. Every month, Marty pilots his bi-plane, traveling into the bush in search of the wolverine and lynx pelts he needs to make a living. While he's on the Black River, he must hunt moose and caribou to survive in the wilderness. Together, they represent America's true MOUNTAIN MEN.

programme.title: Mountain Men
programme.desc: There are men in America who must still make their living off the land; hunting and trapping to provide for their families. They are MOUNTAIN MEN. Their very survival is predicated on utilizing ancient skills perfected over hundreds of years. This series features a variety of men from Appalachia to the Rocky Mountains to Alaska and follows them as they race against winter to obtain the sustenance and money needed to make it through the coldest months of the year. Eustace Conway lives deep in the mountains of North Carolina on the "Turtle Bay Reserve." He moved here two decades ago in search of a more "truthful" existence. In the years since, he's built a home, and survived by hunting, fishing and raising animals. Tom Orr lives with his wife on the Yaak River in Montana. He is 100 miles from the nearest town, a place he hasn't ventured to in 10 years. John is a trapper by trade and to prepare for winter, he must earn enough money to obtain the supplies he needs. Marty Meierotto, his wife Dominique and their daughter Noah live in the small Alaskan town of Two Rivers. Every month, Marty pilots his bi-plane, traveling into the bush in search of the wolverine and lynx pelts he needs to make a living. While he's on the Black River, he must hunt moose and caribou to survive in the wilderness. Together, they represent America's true MOUNTAIN MEN.

Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Blackbeard is said to have stowed away a treasure worth millions of dollars. After centuries of searching, the legendary hoard remains missing. As new evidence is unearthed, the mystery endures: what became of Blackbeard's lost treasure?

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens: Origins
programme.desc: The Great Pyramid of Giza remains as one of the biggest mysteries of the world, with evidence suggesting it may have been an ancient power plant. Could these structures hold the key to unraveling the truth about humanity's extraterrestrial past?

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: The emperors are the largest and strongest of all penguins, living in the coldest, most extreme place on Earth. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory embeds with an Antarctic colony and encounters social skills never filmed before. As the planet rapidly warms, he discovers bonds forged from birth between family, friends and strangers are the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: It takes a special type of courageous penguin to survive the fierce Southern Ocean, but forty million crowd its isolated, rocky outposts. They are the most successful penguins on Earth. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory follows the rockhoppers, gentoos and macaronis to discover a world of risk-takers, rebels, and unconventional parents.

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. We'll also see penguin chicks daring to take the leap, an unlikely team of mismatched teenagers, and others learning how to weather and thrive in the coldest climates, thanks to their snowy homeschooling, some very dedicated parents, and a lot of trial and error.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

From thirsty koalas to kickboxing kangaroos, from cheeky car-surfing parrots to some very angry wombats, our experts explain the animal antics behind the extraordinary wildlife Down Under.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Attack of the Big Cats
programme.desc: There are nearly 40 different species of cats running around out there, but only four make it into the big cat club. The lion, tiger, leopard and jaguar. And they're armed with an arsenal of weapons and bulk to back up one hell of an attitude. In their world, nothing is small and many things are surprising. So get ready to find out what really makes a big cat a big cat. It's not always all about size, you know.

programme.title: Dr. Oakley: Yukon Vet Compilations
programme.desc: For Dr Michelle Oakley, every day is jam-packed with new adventures and challenges. As the only all-species vet in the area of the Yukon, she regularly makes house calls across thousands of square miles to make sure all injured animals get immediate, individualized quality care they need. In this programme, we follow the experienced veterinarian as she takes on the most extreme tasks, from animal rescue missions to complex pet surgeries.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: British author, television presenter and wildlife expert, Nigel Marven, travels the world to find the deadliest species of snake. In each episode Marven travels to a new country or continent and reveals the top 10 deadliest snakes that inhabit that region. From Costa Rica's black-headed bushmaster to South Africa's infamous black mamba, China's king cobra to Mexico's terciopelo, we uncover the most dangerous snakes on our planet. Known for his bold and impulsive approach to animals in the wild, Marven must be on full alert, as a bite from these slithering serpents could paralyse or even kill him.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: Across Africa's vast landscapes, a stunning array of habitats hosts venomous strikers and iconic constrictors, each perfectly tuned to its niche. In South Africa's heartland, the notorious black mamba terrifies a family of elephants before slinking into a tense duel for a discerning mate. Cobras clash with rivals, even among themselves, flaunting hoods that signal speed and relentless power. And in Egypt's searing heat-and-dust lands, survival favors cunning vipers who reign — not through size or strength, but with masterful camouflage and venom delivered with precision.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Future Cat

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

They are cadets at Top Wing Academy with the best of the best students and have access to the most advanced technology. By operating different vehicles like a submarine, a boat, a jet or a motorcycle, the cadets learn how to work as a team and are the first to rush to the rescue to those in trouble. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige e interpreta, con Gal Gadot e Annette Bening, l'adattamento del giallo di Agatha Christie. In crociera sul Nilo, Poirot indaga sull'omicidio di un'ereditiera.

programme.desc: Dal romanzo-cult di Stefano Benni, commedia con Claudio Bisio e Giuseppe Battiston. Buffi personaggi si avvicendano in un bar degli anni 70, fra racconti tragicomici e aneddoti leggendari.

programme.title: La valle dei sorrisi
programme.desc: In un tranquillo paese di montagna, un insegnante di educazione fisica si trasferisce per lavoro. Scopre presto che l'apparente serenità del luogo nasconde un inquietante segreto che minaccia di alterare la sua vita e quella dei suoi abitanti.

programme.title: La Piccola Amelie
programme.desc: Amélie è una bambina belga nata in Giappone. Grazie al suo amico, Nishio San, il mondo è pieno di avventure e scoperte. Il giorno del suo terzo compleanno, un evento cambia il corso della sua vita.

programme.title: Horizon: An American Saga - Capitolo 1

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.desc: Grande successo per il film di Silvio Soldini ispirato a una storia vera. Germania 1943. Un gruppo di donne è reclutato per testare che i pasti di Hitler non siano avvelenati.

programme.desc: L’indimenticabile Audrey Hepburn nei panni di una provinciale in scalata sociale a New York. Al suo fianco George Peppard in un’epocale commedia romantica diretta da Blake Edwards.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.desc: Western di Quentin Tarantino con un supercast. In un rifugio di montagna, otto sconosciuti si scontrano fra minacce, inganni e pallottole. Oscar alle musiche di Ennio Morricone.

programme.desc: Gianni Amelio dirige Luigi Lo Cascio ed Elio Germano nella pellicola che ricostruisce la vicenda umana del caso Braibanti e il bigottismo dell'Italia degli anni 60.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si sfidano a colpi di film candidati agli Oscar che verranno assegnati nella notte tra domenica 2 e lunedì 3 marzo a Los Angeles.

programme.title: L'esercito delle 12 scimmie
programme.desc: Visionario fanta-action di Terry Gilliam con Bruce Willis e Brad Pitt. Anno 2035: un ergastolano viene mandato nel passato per scoprire le cause dell'epidemia che ha decimato l'umanita'.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell
programme.desc: Il manga di culto rivive in un live-action fantascientifico con Scarlett Johansson. Salvata da un incidente, una donna viene trasformata in un cyborg con il compito di fermare il crimine.

programme.title: Lucy
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Morgan Freeman nel fanta-action di Luc Besson. Un criminale inietta una misteriosa sostanza chimica nel corpo di una studentessa che sviluppa poteri sbalorditivi.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Robert Pattinson in un futuro distopico, dal regista di "Parasite". Mickey è destinato a missioni suicide e ad essere clonato ogni volta che muore. Ma la sua versione numero 17 sopravvive a un incidente su un pianeta ostile e si ritrova a convivere con la sua copia numero 18.

programme.title: Blade Runner : Director's Cut
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo venturo un investigatore ha il compito di eliminare un gruppo di androidi assassini in fuga dal loro artefice, ma nel corso della propria ricerca viene a conoscenza di una verità terrificante.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Tom Cruise da un racconto di Philip K. Dick. 2054: tre veggenti prevedono i crimini prima che accadano, ma qualcosa va storto e il capo della polizia viene accusato.

programme.title: Battleship

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Arnold Schwarzenegger nel reboot della celebre saga fantascientifica. Un cyborg viene spedito nel 1984 per uccidere la madre del futuro capo della resistenza contro i robot.

programme.title: Matrix
programme.desc: 4 Oscar a un autentico cult movie con Keanu Reeves e Laurence Fishburne. Un hacker scopre che la realta' in cui viviamo e' una simulazione architettata per tenere sotto scacco l’umanita'.

programme.title: Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della strepitosa saga di fantascienza con Keanu Reeves e Laurence Fishburne. Neo lotta senza tregua per evitare la distruzione di Zion e salvare Trinity da un oscuro destino.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Gravity

La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: La strada per El Dorado
programme.desc: Viaggio nel Nuovo Mondo in una pellicola di animazione targata Dreamworks. 1519: fuggiti da un galeone spagnolo, due imbroglioni cercano il leggendario tesoro della città di El Dorado.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: John Cusack e Thomas Jane ("Hung - Ragazzo squillo") in uno sfrenato action ad altissima velocita'. Simon Keller, un famoso ladro americano, ha bisogno di un autista per mettersi in salvo dopo una rapina in banca. Alla fine la scelta cade su Peter Roberts, un ex pilota di Formula Uno, all'oscuro dei piani del criminale. Keller lo assume come istruttore e mette a segno il colpo proprio durante una delle lezioni di guida. Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.title: 47 Ronin
programme.desc: Viaggio nella mitologia giapponese con Keanu Reeves. Il mezzosangue Kai si unisce a un esercito di samurai pronti a vendicare il loro padrone, obbligato a suicidarsi dal tiranno Lord Kira.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Action con Robert De Niro e John Travolta. Un ufficiale americano si ritira sui monti per dimenticare gli orrori della guerra in Bosnia. La visita di un ex soldato serbo riapre le ferite.

programme.title: La furia dei titani
programme.desc: Sam Worthington, Liam Neeson e Ralph Fiennes in un action mitologico. Il semidio Perseo intraprende una pericolosa missione per liberare Zeus, imprigionato dal capo dei titani, Kronos.

programme.title: Copshop - Scontro a fuoco
programme.desc: Action con Gerard Butler, Frank Grillo e Alexis Louder. Un distretto di polizia di provincia diviene teatro di guerra tra un killer, un astuto truffatore e una poliziotta alle prime armi.

programme.title: I tre moschettieri
programme.desc: Un cast di stelle per la rivisitazione di un avventuroso classico. Lo spavaldo D'Artagnan si unisce ai moschettieri del Re per smascherare gli intrighi del Cardinale Richelieu.

programme.title: Way Down - Rapina alla Banca di Spagna
programme.desc: Action targato Sky Original di Jaume Balaguer con Freddie Highmore. Uno studente di ingegneria escogita un piano per rubare un leggendario tesoro dall'inviolabile Banca di Spagna.

programme.title: Un uomo sopra la legge
programme.desc: Action con Liam Neeson al confine tra Messico e Stati Uniti. Un allevatore, veterano del Vietnam, difende un bambino immigrato dagli implacabili assassini di un cartello del narcotraffico.

programme.title: King Arthur: Il potere della spada

programme.desc: Il cacciatore di vampiri Wesley Snipes, ispirato a un fumetto della Marvel Comics, torna in un secondo episodio sempre più ricco di d'azione e combattimenti. Questa volta dovrà vedersela con un terribile nemico, Jared Nomak, a capo di una nuova e più spietata razza di mutanti che fa strage di uomini e di vampiri per dominare il mondo. Solo la precaria alleanza proprio con i vampiri, che Blade ha sempre combattuto. potrà dare una speranza all'umanità. Fra discoteche e fogne, la caccia al mutante è aperta, ma Blade scoprirà una verità sconcertante.

programme.desc: Nat Wolff e Alexander Skarsgard in un film tratto da una storia vera. Afghanistan: in un plotone incaricato di stanare terroristi, un soldato entra in conflitto con il suo superiore.

programme.desc: L'intramontabile storia del Re della giungla con Alexander Skarsgard, Margot Robbie e Samuel L. Jackson. Dopo tanti anni a Londra, Tarzan torna in Congo ma viene coinvolto in un complotto.

Con una innovativa tecnica chirurgica, un agente dell'FBI 'indossa' la faccia del terrorista Castor Troy, responsabile di numerosi attentati e finito in coma dopo un incidente. Assumendone l'identita', vuole farsi rivelare dal fratello di Castor il nascondiglio di una bomba micidiale che si annida nel cuore di Los Angeles. Ma quando Castor si risveglia, costringe il chirurgo a trapiantargli la faccia dell'agente creando cosi' uno sbalorditivo rovesciamento di ruoli...

programme.desc: Aaron Johnson, John Travolta e Benicio Del Toro in un thriller di Oliver Stone. Due giovani coltivatori di marijuana entrano in conflitto con i crudeli narcotrafficanti messicani.

programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della saga action con Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, 'The Rock' e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic e Brian riuniscono la vecchia squadra per contrastare una banda di piloti criminali.

programme.desc: Christopher Nolan racconta la genesi di Batman con Christian Bale, Liam Neeson e Morgan Freeman. Dopo l'uccisione dei genitori, Bruce Wayne si sottopone a uno speciale addestramento.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: Vetro
programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.title: Crawl - Intrappolati
programme.desc: Durante un uragano, Haley ignora gli ordini di evacuazione per cercare il padre scomparso. Dopo averlo trovato gravemente ferito nella casa di famiglia, i due rimangono intrappolati dalle acque e da un branco di giganteschi alligatori.

programme.title: Suburra
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Elio Germano, Claudio Amendola e Alessandro Borghi nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Tra corruzione dilagante e malavita si consuma la feroce lotta per il potere a Roma.

programme.desc: Daniel Craig e un super cast in una movimentata commedia-thriller. Un detective indaga sulla famiglia di un ricco scrittore per scoprirne l'assassino.

programme.title: L'ombra del dubbio
programme.desc: Un uomo si trasferisce presso dei parenti: la nipote si invaghisce di lui, ma presto si rende conto che potrebbe essere lui il killer ricercato dalla polizia... Capolavoro di suspance del re del brivido.

programme.title: Shining
programme.desc: Jack Nicholson nel capolavoro di Kubrick tratto da Stephen King. Dopo aver accettato l'impiego di custode, uno scrittore si trasferisce con la famiglia in un remoto hotel di montagna.

programme.desc: Andy Muschietti dirige il primo capitolo horror tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. un gruppo di ragazzini si allea per sconfiggere il malvagio clown colpevole delle sparizioni di bambini.

Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.desc: Thriller con Ben Affleck e Morgan Freeman nel quarto film basato su Jack Ryan, il personaggio creato da Tom Clancy. Il giovane analista della CIA deve fermare un gruppo di terroristi.

programme.title: Occhiali neri
programme.desc: Dario Argento torna alla regia di un horror con Ilenia Pastorelli e Asia Argento. In una Roma immersa nelle tenebre, una escort non vedente finisce nel mirino di un serial killer.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Carice van Houten e Guy Pearce in un thriller di Brian De Palma. Due agenti di Copenaghen, sulle tracce di un killer, vengono coinvolti in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: American Night
programme.desc: Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Emile Hirsch e Paz Vega in un thriller di Alessio Della Valle. Le strade di un boss e di un mercante d'arte si incrociano dopo il furto di un'opera di Andy Warhol.

programme.title: Red Lights
programme.desc: Robert De Niro sfida Sigourney Weaver e Cillian Murphy in un thriller paranormale. Un medium non vedente torna alla ribalta dopo trent’anni. 2 studiosi vogliono smascherare i suoi imbrogli.

programme.title: America Latina
programme.desc: Elio Germano nello spiazzante thriller dei fratelli D'Innocenzo. Latina: un dentista vive in una villa con la sua famiglia. Un giorno, scendendo nelle cantine, incontra l'assurdo.

programme.desc: Le ceneri di un passato criminale tornano a vivere con Frank Grillo, Marguerite Moreau e Luke Grimes. Un ex rapinatore inizia una nuova vita, ma la vendetta dei vecchi soci lo perseguita.

programme.title: 2 Young 4 Me - Un fidanzato per mamma
programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer e Paul Rudd in una commedia romantica. La quarantenne divorziata Rosie, sceneggiatrice di una serie tv, si infatua di un affascinante attore molto più giovane di lei.

programme.title: Amici, amanti e...
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.title: Secret Love
programme.desc: Dramma romantico con Josh O'Connor, Odessa Young, Olivia Colman e Colin Firth. Inghilterra, 1924: una cameriera incontra di nascosto il suo amante, che sta per sposare un'altra donna.

programme.desc: Oscar ai costumi per la pellicola di Paul Thomas Anderson con un formidabile Daniel Day-Lewis. Londra, anni 50: la vita di un rinomato stilista viene turbata dall'infatuazione per una donna.

programme.desc: Domhnall Gleeson e Rachel McAdams in una commedia romantica di Richard Curtis. A 21 anni Tim scopre di poter viaggiare nel tempo e usa questa abilita' per sistemare la sua vita.

programme.desc: Sarah Felberbaum ed Eduardo Noriega in una commedia di Gianni Costantino, tra Malta e la Puglia. Due sconosciuti organizzano un finto matrimonio per intascare i soldi dei regali di nozze.

programme.desc: Commedia corale di Carlo Vanzina con Alessandro Gassmann ed Enrico Brignano in un intreccio di storie d'amore clandestine e ritorni di fiamma tra architetti, avvocati e psicanalisti.

programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Henry Golding in una romantica commedia scandita dalle canzoni di George Michael. Londra: Kate sbarca il lunario lavorando in un negozio durante il periodo natalizio, mentre coltiva il sogno di diventare una cantante. L’incontro con Tom cambierà la sua vita.

programme.desc: Commedia romantica con la partecipazione di Celine Dion. Per lenire il dolore, Mira continua a inviare messaggi al fidanzato defunto, ignara che il numero è stato riassegnato.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.desc: Peter Cattaneo ("Full Monty") dirige un biopic al femminile con Kristin Scott Thomas. Per sopportare l'assenza dei mariti in missione in Afghanistan, alcune donne formano un coro musicale.

programme.desc: Mentre affrontano ostacoli inaspettati, i legami di una famiglia vengono messi alla prova, rivelando la complessità dell'amore e della crescita all'interno di una famiglia.

programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Nicholas Sparks, un dramma sentimentale con Kevin Costner, Robin Wright e Paul Newman. Da quando è morta la moglie, Garrett Blake ha perso ogni entusiasmo per la vita. Theresa Osbourne è una giornalista che ha trovato un messaggio in una bottiglia sulla spiaggia, firmato "G". Colpita dalle parole appassionate del testo, si mette sulle tracce di quell'uomo misterioso che affida al mare i suoi messaggi d'amore. Fino in North Carolina, dove vive un costruttore di barche con un doloroso passato da dimenticare.

A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Al Pacino e un cast di divi per descrivere il mondo del football americano attraverso la storia di un allenatore in crisi, alla guida di una squadra che non sa piu' vincere. Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

programme.desc: Juli Grabenhenrich e Luca Marinelli in un dramma familiare scritto e diretto da Alissa Jung. Una quindicenne tedesca giunge a Rimini per incontrare finalmente il padre biologico italiano, confrontandosi con l'uomo vulnerabile e tormentato che non l'ha mai voluta conoscere.

programme.title: The Son
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman, Laura Dern, Vanessa Kirby e Anthony Hopkins in un toccante dramma familiare. Segnato dal divorzio dei genitori, un adolescente problematico chiede di stare con il padre.

programme.title: Nato il quattro luglio
programme.desc: Due Oscar al biopic di Oliver Stone con Tom Cruise. La vera storia di Ron Kovic: rimasto paralizzato nell'inferno del Vietnam, torna in patria e diventa un leader pacifista.

programme.title: Intervista a Matilda De Angelis
programme.desc: Matilda De Angelis, protagonista del film "La lezione" con Stefano Accorsi, ci racconta aneddoti e curiosità sul set del thriller diretto da Stefano Mordini.

programme.title: Napoli - New York
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores dirige Pierfrancesco Favino in un dramma tratto da un soggetto di Federico Fellini e Tullio Pinelli. Napoli, 1949: con la speranza di ritrovare la sorella, l'orfanella Celestina si imbarca da clandestina con l'amico Carmine su una nave per New York.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Napoli velata
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek dirige Giovanna Mezzogiorno e Alessandro Borghi fra sensualita' e mistero. Napoli: la vita di un'anatomopatologa viene sconvolta dal passionale incontro con uno sconosciuto.

programme.title: Le cose che non ti ho detto
programme.desc: Annette Bening e Bill Nighy in un film sulla separazione. Edward annuncia alla moglie Grace di voler divorziare dopo 30 anni di matrimonio. Una decisione che spiazza tutta la famiglia.

programme.title: 18 regali
programme.desc: Ispirato a una storia vera, Francesco Amato dirige Vittoria Puccini, Benedetta Porcaroli ed Edoardo Leo. Una donna incinta reagisce a un destino crudele con un’idea speciale per sua figlia.

programme.title: Gioventù bruciata
programme.desc: Un classico intramontabile che consacrò il mito di James Dean. Nell'America degli anni '50 un gruppo di ragazzi inquieti e tormentati si ribella al mondo degli adulti. Una generazione allo sbando alla ricerca della propria strada, alla ricerca del brivido ogni oltre limite. Golden Globe a Natalie Wood, nel film d'esordio per un allora diciannovenne Dennis Hopper. Uscito nella sale americane a breve distanza dalla morte di James Dean, avvenuta proprio in un incidente stradale il 30 settembre 1955, quando l'attore aveva girato appena tre film.

programme.title: Mystic River
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.title: Orlando
programme.desc: Daniele Vicari dirige una favola moderna con un intenso Michele Placido. In Belgio per rivedere il figlio ricoverato in ospedale, un anziano contadino scopre di avere una nipote.

programme.title: A.C.A.B.
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Marco Giallini e Filippo Nigro nella pellicola di Stefano Sollima. Reduci dal G8 di Genova, 3 celerini affrontano l'odio dei cittadini e una vita privata allo sbando.

programme.title: Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Fabrizio Moro debutta alla regia con Alessio De Leonardis in un film con Giacomo Ferrara e Vinicio Marchioni. Roma: un ragazzo di borgata cerca nella boxe il riscatto da una vita difficile.

programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica

Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Il piccolo incidente innesca una serie di colpi di scena e reazioni inaspettate in un dibattito che coinvolgerà docenti, alunni e parenti. Tratto dall’opera teatrale di Stefano Massini. Rolando Ravello è stato fra gli sceneggiatori del fortunatissimo "Perfetti sconosciuti".

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc:
Behind every great love is a great story.

In Seabrook, South Carolina in the 1940s, teenaged debutante Allie Hamilton and local boy Noah Calhoun spend one passionate, carefree summer together and deeply in love. But when the summer ends, war and duty separate the young couple.

Today, an elderly man visits a nursing home to read from his notebook to a woman whose memory is fading. As he spins a tale of two young lovers with their whole lives before them, his beloved Allie relives a long-ago passion that has never died, an unbreakable bond between two ordinary people rendered extraordinary by the strength, power and beauty of true love.

Based on the novel by Nicholas Sparks, author of A Walk to Remember and Message in a Bottle.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).
